title: Create long-term callback planning module chatbot/memory/callback_planner.py
description:
Create chatbot/memory/callback_planner.py to implement a long-term callback planning mechanism. This allows companions to register, queue, and retrieve topics to raise in future conversations.

Before editing, inspect:
- chatbot/memory/ to ensure consistency with existing memory modules.
acceptance_criteria: The module exposes functions or classes to schedule and retrieve future callback topics
forbidden_changes: modify existing database structures without backward-compatibility layers
